resources.string: GTL records your route on this phone only. It does not send location, IMEI, or SIM identifiers to any server. Do not interact with the app while driving. You use it at your own risk. Logging runs as a visible foreground service with a notification.
Add MAPS_API_KEY to local.properties, then rebuild. OSM offline maps still work after download.
Open the system location panel to turn GPS on or choose high accuracy.
Show last logged route on map

Allow location when asked. GPS and Compass update as soon as the app is open. Tap Start to record a route into SQLite on this phone, draw it on the Map, and fill the Route totals. Tap Stop to end the session. Menu → Saved tracks to delete a route or show it on the map. Settings picks usage (motorbike is the default), units, and whether the last track stays on the map. Download an OSM region for offline maps. Nothing is uploaded to our servers.

Live satellite counts (GPS L1/L5, Galileo, GLONASS, BeiDou, QZSS, NavIC), SNR quality, latitude, longitude, accuracy, provider, altitude, ambient temperature, and logging status. Temperature is the hardware sensor value, or 0 if this phone has no ambient sensor. While logging, GTL stores points more often when you move slowly or turn, and more rarely at high speed — same speed bands as the 2014 logger.
Session totals after Start: elapsed time, odometer, time moving, time waiting, speed, average speed, altitude, bearing, and temperature range when the sensor exists.

Centers on your current location when you open the tab. After Start it follows you and draws the recorded track. A light purple circle around you is the GPS accuracy (radius equals the accuracy in metres). Turn it off in Settings. With “Show last logged route on map” a saved track stays visible. Saved tracks → Show on map opens that session here.
Magnetic heading in degrees and a live compass dial. Works without Start, using the phone rotation sensor.

Menu → Share KMZ sends the current track as a KMZ file (KML plus play, pause, and stop icons). Open it with an external app such as Google Earth. If Google Earth is not installed, get it from Play Store, then open the shared file. Tap the play, pause, or stop icons on the map to see that point’s details.
Waiting for a GNSS fix. In a tunnel this drops to Poor.
Local GPS track logger. No account, no ads, no IMEI, no remote tracking.
Your route stays on this phone.
